headline: Oil Slips Toward $111 as Report Indicates Trump to Give Iran Diplomacy Time
summary: Brent crude slipped toward $111 a barrel following a report that diplomacy with Iran will be given more time.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy commodity, and geopolitical developments in the Middle East significantly influence supply expectations and price volatility.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Reports of extended diplomacy with Iran reduced supply risk premiums, causing Brent to slip toward $111.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Easing geopolitical tensions regarding Iran lowers perceived supply disruption risks, directly pressuring crude oil prices downward.
